name: Revolution Performance Fabrics
old_description: Founded in 2014, Revolution is part of STI Fabrics — a North Carolina mill weaving performance fabric since 1964. Our
about:
Revolution Performance Fabrics operates from Kings Mountain, North Carolina, where it has woven performance upholstery fabrics since launching in 2014 as a brand under STI Fabrics — a mill that has been producing textiles in the region since 1964. The company is part of a family-owned textile heritage, though the current ownership structure is not publicly detailed.

The mill designs and weaves its fabrics using Olefin yarn and upcycled fibers, producing stain-resistant, bleach-cleanable materials that are free of PFAS, formaldehyde, heavy metals, phenols, phthalates, and flame retardants. The product range includes jacquards, solids, chenilles, and machine-washable options for both indoor and outdoor applications, all manufactured at the Kings Mountain facility. Specific production volumes, headcount, and equipment details are not disclosed.

The fabrics serve residential furniture makers, outdoor furniture manufacturers, interior designers, and drapery workrooms. Revolution’s trade program caters to members of ASID, IDS, and VRD, offering preferred pricing and dedicated support. Customer reviews highlight use cases such as reupholstering patio furniture and specifying fabrics for client projects, with the Heritage Collection — tailored stripes, plush chenille, and textured wovens — cited as a recent addition.

The brand was created to demonstrate that high-performance upholstery does not require “forever chemicals.” By eliminating PFAS and other hazardous substances while maintaining durability and cleanability, Revolution positions its PFAS-free construction as a safer choice for homes with children and pets.
